items.answer: Thou shalt not steal.
Ye shall not observe their judgments.
As for us, we will cut down trees from the mountain.
Pursue after him.
I have promised to keep thy words.
The rulers of this people

items.prompt: מִי יִשְׁכֹּן בְּהַר יהוה הוֹלֵךְ תָּמִים וּפֹעֵל צֶדֶק וְדֹבֵר אֱמֶת בִּלְבָבוֹ
items.answer: Who shall dwell on the mount of Yahweh? One who walks perfectly, and works righteousness, and speaks truth in his heart.

items.prompt: בָּא יוֹסֵף מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לִקְבֹּר אֶת־יַעֲקֹב
items.answer: Joseph came from the land of Egypt to bury Jacob.

items.prompt: קָבְרוּ אֶת־נִבְלַת הַנָּבִיא הַזָּקֵן בַּקֶּבֶר אֲשֶׁר אִישׁ הָאֱלֹהִים קָבוּר שָׁם
items.answer: They buried the corpse of the aged prophet in the grave where the man of God was buried.
The sons of Jacob went down to Egypt to buy food.

items.prompt: וְעַתָּה קְבֹץ אֵלַי אֶת־כָּל־יִשְׂרָאֵל אֶל־הַר הַכַּרְמֶל וְאֶת־נְבִיאֵי הַבַּעַל אַרְבַּע מֵאוֹת אֹכְלֵי שֻׁלְחַן אִיזָבֶל
items.answer: And now gather to me all Israel to mount Carmel and the prophets of the Ba'al four hundred, that eat at Jezebel's table.

items.prompt: וּדְבוֹרָה אִשָּׁה נְבִיאָה הִיא שֹׁפְטָה אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל בָּעֵת הַהִיא וְהִיא יוֹשֶׁבֶת תַּחַת־תֹּמֶר דְּבוֹרָה בְּהַר אֶפְרָיִם
items.answer: Now Deborah, a prophetess, was judging Israel at that time, and she used to sit under Deborah's palm in the hill-country of Ephraim.

items.prompt: אָמַר אֱלֹהִים אֶל־אֲבִימֶלֶךְ בַּחֲלוֹם הַלַּיְלָה הִנֵּה אַתָּה מֵת עַל־הָאִשָּׁה אֲשֶׁר לָקַחְתָּ וְהִיא בְּעֻלַת בָּעַל
items.answer: God said to Abimelech in a dream of the night, Behold, thou art a dead man because of the woman whom thou hast taken, for she is a married woman.
Thine enemies will pursue after thee no more.
On that day I will pour out my spirit upon all flesh.
אֶרְדֹּף אַחֲרֶיהָ

items.prompt: I promised (said) to pursue after them.
items.answer: אָמַרְתִּי לִרְדֹּף אַחֲרֵיהֶם
רְדֹף (or רִדְפוּ) אַחֲרָיו

items.prompt: He set the stars in the firmament of the heavens to rule over the night.
items.answer: נָתַן אֶת־הַכּוֹכָבִים בִּרְקִיעַ הַשָּׁמַיִם לִמְשֹׁל בַּלָּיְלָה
יִשְׁפֹּט יְהוָה אֶת־הָעָם הַזֶּה

items.prompt: A city shedding blood like water
items.answer: עִיר שֹׁפֶכֶת דָּם כַּמָּיִם
שְׁמֹר לְשׁוֹנְךָ מֵרָע

items.prompt: Ye shall keep the commandments of your God with all your heart.
items.answer: תִּשְׁמְרוּ אֶת־מִצְוֹת אֱלֹהֵיכֶם בְּכָל־לְבַבְכֶם

items.prompt: They left off counting the proverbs of his lips, for they (were) as the sand which (is) upon the shore of the sea.
items.answer: חָדְלוּ לִסְפֹּר אֶת־מִשְׁלֵי שְׂפָתָיו כִּי הֵם כַּחוֹל אֲשֶׁר עַל שְׂפַת הַיָּם

items.prompt: His commandments and his words will we keep.
items.answer: אֶת־מִצְוֹתָיו וְאֶת־דְּבָרָיו נִשְׁמֹר

items.prompt: His children (sons) will keep his covenant.
items.answer: יִשְׁמְרוּ בָנָיו אֶת־בְּרִיתוֹ
יָדַיִם שֹׁפְכוֹת דָּם

items.prompt: But I would seek unto God.
items.answer: וַאֲנִי אֶדְרֹשׁ אֶל־אֱלֹהִים
בָּא לִשְׁפֹּךְ דָּם

items.prompt: We will burn your city with (in the) fire.
items.answer: נִשְׂרֹף אֶת־עִירְכֶם בָּאֵשׁ
